inputs.description: Password of the admin user, created at the first start. Change it in Miniflux after you sign in; the Secret is not applied again.
inputs.name: adminPassword

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 65534 运行，文件系统只读，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也去掉了所有额外的系统权限。对外连接没有限制。安装完只有 admin 一个用户。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 65534 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也拿掉了所有額外的系統權限。對外連線沒有限制。安裝完只有 admin 一個使用者。

zh-CN.mitigation: Miniflux 默认会拒绝私有网络地址。模板没有限制对外连接，需要限制时，请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则）。
zh-CN.risk: 服务器会去抓取用户指定地址的订阅源。

zh-TW.mitigation: Miniflux 預設會拒絕私有網路位址。範本沒有限制對外連線，需要限制時，請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則）。
zh-TW.risk: 伺服器會去抓使用者指定位址的訂閱源。

risks.mitigation: Miniflux refuses private network addresses by default. The template does not limit outbound traffic. To limit it, add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic).
risks.risk: The server fetches feeds from addresses that users choose.

zh-CN.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个数据库集群各建一组权限。Miniflux 的 Pod 没有令牌。
zh-CN.risk: 数据库 Pod（CloudNativePG）会用数据库 operator 创建的身份去调用 Kubernetes API。

zh-TW.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個資料庫叢集各建一組權限。Miniflux 的 Pod 沒有權杖。
zh-TW.risk: 資料庫 Pod（CloudNativePG）會用資料庫 operator 建立的身分去呼叫 Kubernetes API。

risks.mitigation: The cloudnative-pg component creates separate permissions for each database cluster. The Miniflux Pod has no token.
risks.risk: The database pods (CloudNativePG) call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the database operator creates.

security.summary: The container runs as UID 65534 with a read-only filesystem, no Kubernetes token and all extra system privileges removed. Outbound traffic is not limited. After installation, only the admin user exists.

sql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE is_admin

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: miniflux
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: miniflux
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: miniflux
        app.kubernetes.io/name: miniflux
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 65534
        runAsGroup: 65534
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: miniflux
        image: miniflux/miniflux:2.3.5@sha256:8fd6c3c434ecc3d4083306f83e03c0bb74c632e0f8378da5ead7e1773b0b89c9
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 512Mi
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: miniflux-db-app
              key: password
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          value: postgres://miniflux:$(DATABASE_PASSWORD)@miniflux-db-rw:5432/miniflux?sslmode=verify-full&sslrootcert=/db-ca/ca.crt
        - name: RUN_MIGRATIONS
          value: '1'
        - name: CREATE_ADMIN
          value: '1'
        - name: ADMIN_USERNAME
          value: admin
        - name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: miniflux-secrets
              key: admin-password
        - name: LISTEN_ADDR
          value: 0.0.0.0:8080
        - name: BASE_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}/
        volumeMounts:
        - name: db-ca
          mountPath: /db-ca
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthcheck
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 60
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthcheck
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthcheck
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: db-ca
        secret:
          secretName: miniflux-db-ca
          items:
          - {key: ca.crt, path: ca.crt}
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 64Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: miniflux
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: miniflux
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: miniflux
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: miniflux-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: miniflux
            port:
              number: 8080
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: miniflux-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: miniflux
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:18-minimal-trixie@sha256:0675340b02be838319b9b6f323c206693e519dcd62ec729d539be9f46bb7a2f9
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: miniflux
      owner: miniflux
      encoding: UTF8
  storage:
    size: 5Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: '1'
      memory: 1Gi
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: 128MB
      max_connections: '100'
